referenceFunction.generalComment: The consumption of lubricating oil are taken from ecoinvent v2.2, as well as emission patern during the combustion. Values for CO2, CO, NOx, CH4 and NMHC were taken from the Non-road database and represent average factors for gasoline-powered, four-stroke, hand-guided tamping rammers and vibratory plates. UUID: ce890b07-c419-41bf-83b9-ff19734f38f6
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset is based on the process "Diesel, burned in building machine {GLO}|". Compared to this reference process, the dataset includes only lubricating oil, diesel fuel and the emissions produced during the combustion of 1 MJ of petrol fuel in an average building machine in Switzerland.
